approvers: Nobody else; I decide alone, but the client or developer would have to accept the extra line in the quote
reason: ACHV is a contractor too and I don't want them on my site or seeing my programme. I have never paid for this, my crew tapes and covers the frames when needed, and damage at handover is cheaper to fix than a new budget line plus a new supplier.
objection: A competitor on my site with no Maltese reference job, and a coating on glass that I would have to answer for if it goes wrong, whatever the 2,500 cap says.
instead: Keep using my own crew with cheap protection film and tape, and fix the odd scratched window at handover.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing finished Maltese jobs by contractors I know, with the work done by an independent applicator and ACHV nowhere near my site, and the cost passed to the client as a separate line.
